inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Director and employees were missing the following annual trainings:Director did not have the certificates for Health and Safety audit trainings as follows: Director and 7 caregivers missing   a) (1)Emergency preparedness b) (2)Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases,  including immunizations c) (3)Administering medication, if applicable, including compliance with ?746.3803 of this chapter  (4)Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction (5)Understanding building and physical  premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards,  bodies of water, and vehicular traffic (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with  ?746.3425 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood?)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Operation has not reported their staffing changes for the year 2024 by the due date of 1/15/2025.    NOTE: Director provided proof of compliance same day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Regarding employee records, 2 employees did not have translated education requirements and have yet to be submitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Regarding employee records, 6 Employees were reviewed. The following items were missing: 6 employees were missing a notarized affidavit of employment form2985, 6 employees were missing the pre-employment affidavit,  5 employees were missing their background eligibility, 2 employees have no copy of IDs, 2 employee did not have translated education requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Fire Marshal inspection report was not current.  Last available Inspection was 6/6/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The underliner for the loose fill in the outdoor play area is sticking out near some of the play structure,  creating a tripping hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: 2 out of 4 staff files evaluated did not contain proof of education documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: A caregiver was observed alone with children in the infant room during the inspection and has an ineligible background check status.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation has not been conducting monthly maintenance checklists.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: Bottles were stored on the hand washing sink in the infant room.    Note: The provider removed the bottles during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: 3 out of 4 children's files did not contain a completed health statement as they were not signed by parents and the health care professionals name and address were missing. It has been over 12 months for 2 out of 3 children's files evaluated and a signed health statement from a health care professional is needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: 18 out of 21 children present during the inspection were signed in. 3 children had not been signed in for the day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: A caregiver was observed during the inspection who was counted in ratio. The caregiver has not completed the full 24 hours of pre-service training. An additional 16 hours is needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: Children could not be seen upon entering the infant room due to inadequate lighting duirng naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The ceiling in the boys restroom contains a leak and is beginning to cave in posing a risk to children.     The door to the infant room is missing screws and cannot be opened properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The nap mat list is not updated in the Pre-K classroom. Children were observed sleeping on the incorrect nap mats labeled with a different cild's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: 1 out of 4 caregivers files evaluated did not contain Pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: Documentation of the annual sanitation inspection report was not available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR: Six caregivers need Pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Records were evaluated for six children enrolled and the following was determined:    Five children needed a special needs statement.   Five children needed emergency contact information such as name, address, and phone number.  Five children needed a health statement.   Three children needed immunization records.  One child needed emergency care information such as physician name, address, and phone number.   One child needed school information such as name and phone number of school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation is in need of an annual fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan did not include procedures for evacuating and relocating children who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23,2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who eft employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: Operation did not have the most recent fire inspection report available upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence: Operation did not provide proof of insurance at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence (26 TAC §746.203(1))

occurrences.finding: Pest Extermination: Operation had numerous mosquitoes in the building and in classrooms with children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pest Extermination (26 TAC §746.3427)
